title: Sopatma
description: One of three "emporia" listed in the PME and placed by it after (i.e., northward from) Kamara and Poduke. BAtlas identified it firmly with modern Marakanam, but Dayalan more recently asserts it might be tentatively identified with Mamallapuram.

properties.description: 5M scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
